_comment: Legends, the old ones (docs/ROADMAP.md 0.8.0 and Appendix I; on screen 'legends'). Read by app/legends/catalog.py, which asserts the shape. One is awake at a time; it wakes when the player has defeated `wakeAfterDefeats` creatures since the last one woke, in this order, skipping the defeated; after all five, round two ('the Fog Dragon II') with health × (1 + roundHealthScale × (round - 1)). Health is `phases` phases of `phaseHealth`; a journey's effort is folded with the fight model (world_objects/fight.py) against the current phase's weakTo/resists. A phase's `rune` says what rune lands on it: ANY (any rune shape cut near it, or a woken rune), WOKEN (only a rune woken on a rune ride), or a rune id (only that rune's shape). `stopIsWord`: a stop of `stopSeconds` within the note's reach is a note. A waking tests at most `anchorTries` spots for each legend and `wakeReachTests` in all. Healing is `healPerWeek` of a phase per full week left alone; asleep after `sleepAfterDays`. Text is placeholder for the author.

legends.name: The Fog Dragon
legends.livesAt: the biggest stretch of unexplored tiles near you
legends.flavour: A big grey dragon that naps wherever the map is still unexplored.
legends.page: The Fog Dragon loves the fog and curls up in the middle of it. Explore the tiles around it and it soon has nowhere comfy left to lie.

legends.name: The Water Wyrm
legends.livesAt: water with a path beside it
legends.flavour: A long green wyrm that lazes in the water beside a path.
legends.page: The Water Wyrm likes company and a bit of a chat. Stop beside it, leave it a note, and it will happily move along.

legends.name: The Hill King
legends.livesAt: the highest hill or viewpoint you can reach
legends.flavour: A stout old king who sits on the highest hill around and will not come down.
legends.page: The Hill King thinks the top of his hill is the best seat in the land. Climb up to see him, and leave him a note when you get there.

legends.name: The Trail Wyrm
legends.livesAt: a long trail or cycle route
legends.flavour: A wyrm as long as a trail, stretched out along it from end to end.
legends.page: The Trail Wyrm only shifts for someone who goes a good way along its trail. Keep going past it and it moves over, a bit at a time.

legends.name: The Rune Golem
legends.flavour: A friendly stone giant at an old place, covered in worn-down runes.
legends.page: The Rune Golem was carved a long time ago and only listens to runes. Ride any rune shape beside it, then its own rune, Dagaz, then a rune you have woken.
